critique: The pixel-map squirrel, bobbing acorns, chunky halftone platforms, confetti bursts, and acid yellow–magenta–cyan comic framing turn an autonomous platformer into a genuinely joyful, boldly layered pop-art spectacle. The masked hard-light background video, dual halftones, scanlines, vignette, rotating sunburst, and dense borders compete for attention; simplifying the outer texture stack and giving the squirrel’s path more visual breathing room would sharpen the game’s distinctive living-code premise.
